name: window
description: Window — TikTok for shopping, a discovery-first commerce feed

scripts.build: npm run build -w @window/shared && npm run build -w @window/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @window/shared && npm run typecheck -w @window/server && npm run typecheck -w @window/app
scripts.dev: npm run seed && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
